description: dispatch refuses before any herdr call or chain walk when its `path` argument resolves outside every configured project (accounts.py's NoProjectConfiguredError, raised first thing in _resolve_chain, strictly before any account is even looked at). EXIT_NEEDS_CONFIG (3), naming the configured projects so the fix is obvious.

home.config_toml:
[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"

[roles.explorer]
write_scope = "none"
effort = "low"
on_exhausted = "degrade"
skills = []

[roles.explorer.models]
codex = "gpt-test"

expect.stderr:
no configured project contains <DIR:outside>.
Configured projects:
  - sandbox
Add a [projects.<name>] table with this path, and a chain for the role you want to dispatch.
